title: AgentDock core contracts v1
description: Canonical wire/storage contracts for Project, Task, Session, Event, Approval, Operation, Check and Usage. Source of truth for ADR-0003. Keys and enum values are snake_case. Optional fields are omitted when absent (never null). See docs/contracts/README.md for the Rust/TypeScript mapping.
$comment: Only the JSON Schema keywords listed in docs/contracts/README.md (section 'Schema keyword subset') may be used, so that the stdlib validator in docs/contracts/validate_fixtures.py checks everything this file says.

AuthorityId.description: The store that minted the event cursor. 'local' for the desktop store; 'remote:<name>' for a remote worker journal.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with exactly millisecond precision. The pattern bounds each field; validate_fixtures.py additionally asserts format date-time (rejects e.g. February 30).

Seq.description: Monotonic, gap-free event cursor within one authority. Capped at 2^53-1 so TypeScript numbers stay exact.

RedactedText.description: Text that has already passed the redaction pipeline. Redacted spans are replaced with [REDACTED:<rule>].

RelativePath.description: Forward-slash path relative to a known root (workspace or artifact store). The pattern rejects absolute paths, drive letters, a leading '~', empty segments, '..' and any segment ending in a dot or space other than '.' itself (Windows trims those), backslashes, control characters (including newlines) and Windows-reserved characters. It is a shape check only: the backend MUST canonicalize (resolve symlinks) and verify containment in the root before using a path; never rely on this regex for security.

ArtifactRef.description: Pointer to content moved out of the event row (large output, compacted transcript, check logs).

TextOrRef.description: Inline redacted text, or a reference to it after retention compaction.

ResumePhase.description: Workflow phase, ordered running < verifying < review < pr < ci. Used for the phase an interrupted task had reached (Interruption.phase) and the phase it re-enters after preparing (resume_phase), which may never be later than the phase reached. A retry (failed -> queued) carries no resume_phase and always restarts from running.

ApprovalReturnState.description: State a task returns to once an approval is resolved.

ActorKind.description: Who caused a fact. 'adapter' is AgentDock's own adapter component recording a protocol fact it observed from an ACP agent process (never the agent itself); an agent never changes task state directly. 'recovery' may only write the events listed in checkpoint-and-replay.md (crash recovery). operation.succeeded/failed and check results come only from 'orchestrator' or 'integration'.

HintSource.description: Where a time hint came from. 'unknown' means no reliable source; the hint then carries no time.

phase.description: Furthest workflow phase the task had reached when interrupted: the state left if it is a phase; the approval return_state when leaving awaiting_approval; when leaving preparing, the resume_phase being restored, otherwise running. A later resume may re-enter this phase or an earlier one, never a later one.

auto_resume_armed.description: True only when the reason is quota_exhausted or rate_limited, the task's auto_resume_policy opts in, and retry_hint has a not_before time. Never true on an interruption written by crash recovery (reason host_crashed); an interruption that was already armed before the crash is not touched by recovery.

open_operation_ids.description: Operations whose outcome is unknown and must be reconciled before re-entering pr/ci.

AutoResumePolicy.description: User opt-in for unattended resume. Crash-related interruptions are never auto-resumed.

LaunchMethod.description: new = ACP session/new; load = session/load (requires agentCapabilities.loadSession, agent replays history); resume = session/resume (requires agentCapabilities.sessionCapabilities.resume, no replay).

CapabilitySnapshot.description: What the adapter advertised in the ACP initialize response for one agent process. Features are derived only from advertised capabilities; absent means false.

track.description: v1_stable is the default. v2_draft only behind an explicit opt-in feature flag; validate_fixtures.py rejects v2_draft snapshots until the v2 feature derivation is designed.

acp_agent_capabilities.description: The agentCapabilities object as received, with every _meta key removed. Opaque to AgentDock logic; kept for diagnostics and re-derivation.

client_advertised.description: What AgentDock itself advertised in clientCapabilities for this process.

unstable_opt_ins.description: Names of ACP unstable features explicitly enabled for this adapter (e.g. 'session_fork'). Empty by default.

ApprovalSource.description: acp_permission = an ACP session/request_permission from the agent; host_policy = a gate AgentDock itself enforces (push, PR, merge, destructive command).

ApprovalScope.description: AgentDock-side scope of a grant. ACP allow_always is recorded as the selected option but AgentDock never widens scope beyond what its own policy allows.

PolicyClass.description: Backend policy classification of an ACP permission request (the tool call it would authorize), computed in Rust from the unwrapped command / path / URL (ADR-0002 APR-1..APR-10), never taken from agent text. Classes pr_merge, force_push, branch_delete, worktree_remove, destructive_command and unclassified (command could not be recovered, APR-7) may only be approved by the user. A class that maps to an OperationKind (git_push, external_write, pr_merge, branch_delete, worktree_remove, destructive_command; pr_write runs as pr_create, pr_update or pr_comment; force_push runs as destructive_command) is executed by AgentDock only as an Operation with its own host_policy approval when AgentDock itself runs it (terminal/*, fs/write_text_file).

Repeatability.description: non_repeatable: must never be re-executed without reconciliation and a fresh approval. idempotent_with_key: the target itself dedupes by idempotency_key (only pr_comment and external_write may claim it). Repeatable work (tests, lint) is a Check, not an Operation.

OperationKindRules.description: Binds operation kinds to repeatability and to their identity fields. Git/PR/merge/branch/worktree/destructive operations are always non_repeatable. Each kind requires exactly its identity fields in target (others are forbidden; 'description' is free text and never part of the identity). idempotency_key = sha256(canonical {kind, identity}) where identity = target without 'description'.

ReconcileStrategy.description: Read-only probe used after a crash to learn whether an operation took effect.

OperationState.description: recorded -> started -> succeeded | failed | outcome_unknown; outcome_unknown -> reconciled_*; recorded -> abandoned (never started: approval denied/expired/cancelled/invalidated, task left the phase, or crash recovery).

OperationTarget.description: What an operation acts on. 'description' is shown to the user and is NOT part of the identity; every other field is an identity field, and OperationKindRules fixes which ones each kind must carry.

remote.description: Remote name (git_push; branch_delete when deleting a remote branch, absent for a local branch).

ref.description: Full ref (refs/heads/...) for git_push and branch_delete; the head branch for pr_create.

expected_sha.description: git_push: the commit pushed (must equal the head of the task's latest clean checkpoint); pr_merge: the PR head that may be merged (gh pr merge --match-head-commit); branch_delete: the commit the ref must still point to.

path.description: worktree_remove: the worktree directory relative to the project's worktree root (<repo>.worktrees/), canonicalized by the backend.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact request body AgentDock sends (PR title/body, comment text, external payload), computed before redaction. A digest only; the content itself is never part of the target.

command_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON array of the unwrapped argv (after APR-6 unwrapping, before redaction).

cwd.description: Working directory of a destructive_command, relative to the task worktree root.

endpoint.description: external_write: method and URL template without query values, e.g. 'POST https://api.example.com/v1/items'.

UsageSource.description: provider_reported: a number the agent or provider gave us; locally_estimated: AgentDock computed it (estimator required); unknown: no number exists. The UX source tags Not applicable and Sign-in needed are not values of this enum: they are derived (see ADR-0003 section 7).

ContextWindow.description: Maps ACP v1 UsageUpdate.used / UsageUpdate.size. Describes the model context, not any subscription.

Cost.description: Maps ACP v1 Cost {amount, currency}. 'unit' is an ISO 4217 code or another unit such as 'credits'; AgentDock never converts credits to money.

Usage.description: One usage observation. There is deliberately no field for remaining subscription quota: AgentDock cannot know it, and the UI shows quota as unknown.

scope.description: snapshot: point-in-time value (context window); cumulative: running total for the session (ACP cost); increment: delta for one turn.

local_path.description: Absolute, canonicalized (symlinks resolved) repository root on the authority's host.

external_session_id.description: ACP sessionId, opaque. Only meaningful to the adapter that issued it.

result_acknowledged_at.description: Result viewed: opened, or marked reviewed (one row or bulk). Clears needs_review.

result_opened_at.description: Result actually opened (rendered on screen). Only this satisfies the auto-archive rule; marking reviewed does not.

archived.description: UX 'archived' (docs/ux/states-and-indicators.md section 5). Shown under 'Show N archived sub-tasks'.

restored_by_user.description: The user unarchived it (Undo or Unarchive). Such a session is never auto-archived again.

operation_kind.description: OperationKind for host_policy approvals; always 'tool_call' for ACP permissions (what the tool call does is in classified_kind).

classified_kind.description: ACP permissions only: the backend policy classification of the tool call. Decides who may approve.

operation_fingerprint.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of canonical JSON (keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8, non-ASCII unescaped). For host_policy approvals it equals the operation's idempotency_key = sha256({"kind": kind, "identity": target without description}); for ACP permissions it is sha256({"kind": "tool_call", "target": {tool_call_id, title}}). A grant only authorizes an execution with the same fingerprint.

return_state.description: Present only for task-blocking approvals (requested while the task is running, pr or ci). Absent for non-blocking approvals (verifying/review sessions, terminal-state cleanup).

attempt_count.description: Non-repeatable operations are executed at most once per operation_id. A retry is a new operation that supersedes this one.

command.description: argv after redaction; never a shell string.

AttentionKind.description: The three inbox sections of docs/ux/states-and-indicators.md section 4: needs_reply = 'Needs your reply' (blocked on the user); needs_review = 'New results to review' (a terminal result not yet viewed); background = 'Running in background'.

AcknowledgementMethod.description: How a result was viewed (docs/ux/states-and-indicators.md section 4). 'opened' = the result was rendered on screen while the window had focus; 'marked_reviewed' = the one-row action; 'bulk_marked_reviewed' = 'Mark completed as reviewed' (completed/cancelled results only). Only 'opened' counts as seen for auto-archive.

AttentionItem.description: Derived (never stored) to-do item. Computed purely from events by the rules in docs/contracts/attention.md.

ref_id.description: Approval id or other referenced entity id.

Provenance.description: live: observed as it happened; acp_replay: history re-sent by an agent during session/load (never treated as new work); recovery: written by startup crash recovery.

TaskPolicyUpdatedPayload.description: User changed the task's auto_resume_policy. Disabling disarms an armed interruption; enabling never arms an existing interruption retroactively.

TaskDeletedPayload.description: User deleted a terminal task. Every earlier event of the task is rewritten in place into a tombstone (same id/seq/type/routing fields, empty payload); the seq sequence stays gap-free.

TaskOutcomeAcknowledgedPayload.description: The user viewed the task's result. Allowed in completed, cancelled, failed and interrupted (UX terminal states); bulk_marked_reviewed only for completed and cancelled.

SessionResultAcknowledgedPayload.description: The user viewed a finished session's result. bulk_marked_reviewed only for outcome succeeded or cancelled.

SessionMessageDeltaPayload.description: Coalesced ACP agent_message_chunk / agent_thought_chunk / user_message_chunk text.

SessionToolCallPayload.description: Maps ACP tool_call and tool_call_update. rawInput/rawOutput are never stored inline; they go through redaction into an artifact.

SessionArchivedPayload.description: auto: a child session whose outcome is succeeded/cancelled, whose result was opened, and which the user never restored (the UI emits it only after the user navigated away). user: manual archive, only in a terminal state.

SessionUnarchivedPayload.description: user: Undo or Unarchive (sets restored_by_user; never auto-archived again). system: the archived session entered a waiting state (needs reply) and is unarchived in the same transaction, by the orchestrator, or by the recovery actor while crash recovery is in progress.

acp_outcome.description: What AgentDock answered to session/request_permission. 'cancelled' is mandatory for pending requests when the turn is cancelled.

approval_id.description: The host_policy approval that must be granted before operation.started. Recorded first, requested immediately after.

supersedes_operation_id.description: Only an operation known not to have taken effect (failed with effect none, reconciled_not_applied, reconciled_undeterminable, or abandoned) may be superseded, and only with a fresh approval.

effect.description: Whether the failed attempt is known to have had no external effect.

cause.description: host_crash: written by recovery for an op left started; killed: the orchestrator killed a started op (task cancel or interrupt) before it reported. A started pr_merge is never killed (ADR-0002 PRL-5): cancel/interrupt waits for its result, so pr_merge only becomes outcome_unknown through host_crash.

OperationAbandonedPayload.description: A recorded operation that was never started and never will be. Terminal; it may later be superseded by a new operation with a fresh approval.

tombstone.description: Present only on events rewritten after task.deleted. The payload is then empty and per-type payload rules do not apply.

StreamMessage.description: What a subscriber receives. Not stored. 'lagged' and 'retention_gap' tell the client to re-read from the store instead of trusting the live stream.

FixtureExpectation.description: Sidecar file for a fixture: the projection the event stream must produce.

ModelSamples.description: Sample read-model objects, used to exercise the entity schemas.
